## Help

```text
Optimise a Dry IR file (merge collinear, fit arcs) and report the before/after

Usage: dry optimize [OPTIONS] <FILE>

Arguments:
  <FILE>  

Options:
      --reorder-travel  Also reorder independent extrusion runs to reduce travel. Changes print order
  -o, --out <OUT>       Write the optimised IR JSON to a file
  -h, --help            Print help
```
